paite: Huchi in Solomon in Jerusalem a Moriah tang, apa David kiang a TOUPA kilakna, Jebus mi Ornan phualzang, David sehsa ah TOUPA' inn alam panta hi.
heading: Tempul Lam Patna / (1 Kum 6.1-38)
english: Then Solomon began to build Yahweh’s house at Jerusalem on Mount Moriah, where Yahweh appeared to David his father, which he prepared in the place that David had appointed, on the threshing floor of Ornan the Jebusite.

paite: Avaihawm akum lina kum, akha nihna, ani nih ni inn lam apan hi.
english: He began to build in the second day of the second month, in the fourth year of his reign.

paite: Pathian inn lamdan ding Solomon in angaihtuahdan hichibang ahi. Adunglam tong tehdan ngeina in tong sawmguk ahi a, availam tong sawmnih ahi.
english: Now these are the foundations which Solomon laid for the building of God’s house: the length by cubits after the first measure was sixty cubits, and the width twenty cubits.

paite: Amalam a inlim dunglam inn vailam tan mah tong sawmnih ahi a, asanlam za-le-sawmnih ahi a, asung dangka-eng chi kia in aluan hi.
english: The porch that was in front, its length, across the width of the house, was twenty cubits, and the height one hundred twenty; and he overlaid it within with pure gold.

paite: Dantan lianzaw pen baang ah meilah sing athuap a, huai dangka-eng chi kia in aluan a, huai ah tum sing leh khainiang lim atuangsak hi.
english: He made the larger room with a ceiling of cypress wood, which he overlaid with fine gold, and ornamented it with palm trees and chains.

paite: Huchi in akilawmsak ding in bel suangmantam in azem a, dangka-eng bel Paravaim dangka-eng ahi.
english: He decorated the house with precious stones for beauty. The gold was gold from Parvaim.

paite: Inn bel, kalhkangte, baangte, apialkhangte, kongkhakte dangka-eng in aluan a; baangte ah cherub limte atuangsak hi.
english: He also overlaid the house, the beams, the thresholds, its walls, and its doors with gold, and engraved cherubim on the walls.

paite: Mun Siangthoupen abawl a, adunglam in vailam tan mah, tong sawmnih ahi a, availam tong sawmnih ahi a, dangka-eng chi ngen in aluan a, talent zaguk apha hi.
english: He made the most holy place. Its length, according to the width of the house, was twenty cubits, and its width twenty cubits; and he overlaid it with fine gold, amounting to six hundred talents.

paite: Akilhna gikdan dangka-eng shekel sawmnga ahi. Dantan tungnungte dangka-eng in aluan hi.
english: The weight of the nails was fifty shekels of gold. He overlaid the upper rooms with gold.

paite: Mun Siangthoupen ah cherub lim nih abawl a, huaite dangka-eng in aluan hi.
english: In the most holy place he made two cherubim by carving, and they overlaid them with gold.

paite: Cherub khate'n tong sawmnih akhak a, cherub khat kha tong nga ahi a, baang apha a, huan, akha langkhat leng tong nga mah ahi a, cherub khat kha apha hi.
english: The wings of the cherubim were twenty cubits long: the wing of the one was five cubits, reaching to the wall of the house; and the other wing was five cubits, reaching to the wing of the other cherub.

paite: Huchi in cherub dang khat kha leng tong nga ahi a, baang a pha a; huan, akha langkhat tong nga mah ahi a, cherub khat kha apha hi.
english: The wing of the other cherub was five cubits, reaching to the wall of the house; and the other wing was five cubits, joining to the wing of the other cherub.

paite: Cherubte'n tong sawmnih khak in akha uh azak ua, adingh ua, insung lam nga in adingh uhi.
english: The wings of these cherubim spread themselves out twenty cubits. They stood on their feet, and their faces were toward the house.

paite: Puanzak ding adumpuang, asandup, asan-au, khauzang ngatte in abawl a, huai ah cherub lim atuangsak hi.
english: He made the veil of blue, purple, crimson, and fine linen, and ornamented it with cherubim.

paite: Inn mailam ah tong sawmthum leh tong nga a sang khuam nih aphut a, huaite dawn tong nga tuaktuak ahi.
heading: Dal Khuam Nihte / (1 Kum 7.15-22)
english: Also he made before the house two pillars thirty-five cubits high, and the capital that was on the top of each of them was five cubits.

paite: Huai ah khainiang abawl a, khuam dawn ah avial a; theibuhfai zakhat abawl a, khainiang ah akhai hi.
english: He made chains in the inner sanctuary, and put them on the tops of the pillars; and he made one hundred pomegranates, and put them on the chains.

paite: Tempul mailam ah khuam aphut a, khat taklam ah, khat veilam ah, taklam a pen Jakin achi a, veilam a pen Boaz achi hi.
english: He set up the pillars before the temple, one on the right hand and the other on the left; and called the name of that on the right hand Jachin, and the name of that on the left Boaz.
